method: Native trampolines around the execute entries of TE attention FFI handler bundles. Forwards original metadata queries unchanged and excludes metadata and non-EXECUTE stages from counts. No TE source or build changes.
main_score_mod_cache: External Python wrappers count the previously uninstrumented score-mod cache accesses and graph builds, added to main native-cache totals.
discarded_api_logging: Raw cuDNN API log counts include initialization/warm-up calls and entry/exit messages; those counts are not used in the execution comparison.

runs.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=/tmp/te-attn-execution-stats TE_FFI_PROBE_OUTPUT=/tmp/te-attn-execution-stats/branch-l0.probe.json TE_PROBE_MAIN_SCORE_MOD=0 NVTE_FUSED_ATTN_CACHE_DEBUG=1:all NVTE_ALLOW_NONDETERMINISTIC_ALGO=1 NVTE_JAX_UNITTEST_LEVEL=L0 NVTE_REPORT_IF_CUTEDSL_BACKEND_NOT_CHOSEN=ERROR JAX_ENABLE_COMPILATION_CACHE=false TRITON_PTXAS_PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas python -m pytest -p ffi_probe_plugin -c tests/jax/pytest.ini -v -s --tb=short --junitxml=/tmp/te-attn-execution-stats/branch-l0.xml @/tmp/te-attn-coverage/common-tests.args > /tmp/te-attn-execution-stats/branch-l0.stdout.log 2> /tmp/te-attn-execution-stats/branch-l0.stderr.log
